summary: Batch 1 Reactivation verification complete. Ran 17 pytest cases (all passed) covering short-lead capture, config endpoint, DIY and DWM Stripe checkout sessions (verified amount_total=49700 / 199700 + metadata + success/cancel URLs), intake context security (bogus 404, unpaid 402, recruitment session 404), full DIY intake→course flow with progress persistence, DWM Calendly redirect on submit, claim-purchase rejection for DWM session, reactivation nurture disabled in marketing_service, 403 for recruitment-only member, and recruitment regression on both DIY/direct-project checkouts + short recruitment form. UI verification: /reactivate short 5-field form redirects to /reactivate-with-rooney; training page shows video placeholder, DIY $497 CTA, DWM $3,997/$1,997 CTA, exact guarantee sentence; $497 page has all required copy and CTA; $1,997 proposal has eyebrow + Executive Summary + prices + no forbidden strings ($997/$1,998.50/50%); 5-step reactivation shell renders steps 1-5 with correct titles (Why Boards Disengage / Reactivating Your Board / Having the Difficult Conversation / Equipping Each Board Member / My Board), Module 1 shows Training Video Coming Soon placeholder, Module 5 correctly has no video (shows My Reactivated Board placeholder), Mark This Step Complete button present. /reactivation-start-here has 'START REACTIVATING MY BOARD' CTA. Legacy /reactivate/options still reachable (200).

issues: Step labels rendered as 'STEP 1 / Why Boards Disengage' (two lines) rather than '1. Why Boards Disengage' inline as spec literally states. Functionally correct; call-out only if the exact spec format matters.

critical_code_review_comments: member_routes.claim_recruitment_purchase name is now misleading — it also handles reactivation DIY. Consider renaming to claim_member_purchase for clarity.

STRIPE_DIY_BOARD_REACTIVATION_497_PRICE_ID and STRIPE_DIRECT_BOARD_REACTIVATION_PRICE_ID env vars are empty; code falls back to resolve_offer_price_id by lookup_key. This works today because Stripe has matching price lookup_keys, but adding a live-mode price without setting the env would fail silently — consider a startup assertion in production mode.

reactivation_intake_routes.verified_transaction re-verifies via Stripe only when DB payment_status != 'paid'. That's correct, but purchase_source is trusted from DB — good defense in depth already present.

funnel_service.reactivation_result still requires legacy fields (present_board/active_board/etc.) via KeyError-style access. Batch 1 short form leads have none of those; hitting GET /api/funnel-leads/result/{token} on a new short-form lead will 500. Public flow no longer sends leads there (short form redirects to /reactivate-with-rooney) so it's dormant, but consider guarding reactivation_result with .get() to be safe.
test_credentials: New synthetic members created with pattern test_diy_e2e_*, test_ui_react_*, test_dwm_*. Not cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Multiple funnel_leads (name='TEST *'), payment_transactions (marked paid for E2E DIY + DWM), members, purchases, board_reactivation_intakes, course_progress rows for reactivation_self_guided. All prefixed TEST_ where feasible. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 1 fully passing. Backend suite in tests/test_batch1_reactivation.py + tests/test_batch1_intake_e2e.py — reuse as regression before Batch 2 build. Full Stripe UI card checkout wasn't executed; DIY E2E was validated by marking the payment_transaction as paid in Mongo and directly seeding the entitlement (which is functionally equivalent to a successful claim). If main agent wants a genuine Stripe-card completion test, drive it through the browser with card 4242 and confirm both /purchase/success + intake redirect. Note: STRIPE_DIY_BOARD_REACTIVATION_497_PRICE_ID + STRIPE_DIRECT_BOARD_REACTIVATION_PRICE_ID env vars are blank but price lookup_keys resolve correctly today.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Batch 1.
